text: I like the pendant 3 stars worth ("Pretty Ok") but the .... I like the pendant 3 stars worth ("Pretty Ok") but the image on the pendant I received is more "zomed in" kthe hand touches or dissappears out of the border of the pendant on top and bottom)  and the colors are MUCH less vibrant, kinda like a copy of a copy of a copy-- which honestly is probably exactly what it is. It's still wearable but not nearly as striking as the picture and so I feel pretty blah about it, maybe because I really really liked the pictured pendant.
